assertions.summary: The offline local CI gate succeeded without requiring interactive input or external API setup.
evidence: bun run ci exited 0; stdout/stderr/transcript captured in mission evidence.
CI output ran bun run check && bun test and reported 83 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail.
No smoke/eval command invocation appeared in the CI output.

assertions.summary: The build completed offline and produced a runnable dist/nya artifact whose help and db doctor entrypoints worked from fresh temp directories.
evidence: bun run build exited 0 and rebuilt dist/nya.
dist/nya --help exited 0 and printed the CLI usage banner.
dist/nya db doctor --project --json --no-tui exited 0 in a fresh temp dir; JSON parsed with dbExists=false and no .nya-cli directory was created.

assertions.summary: Required tree-sitter assets are present and direct runtime chunking against the dist runtime succeeds, but the preferred dist/nya learn git user-surface flow fails before completion because the built artifact cannot load sqlite-vec in isolated temp execution.
evidence: dist/tree-sitter listing included web-tree-sitter.wasm and tree-sitter-typescript.wasm.
Direct runtime chunk verification exited 0 and produced 2 chunks, including section "fixture.ts · opsRuntimeAssetMarker".
dist/nya learn git <temp-repo> --project --json --no-tui exited 1 with: "Loadble extension for sqlite-vec not found. Was the sqlite-vec-linux-x64 package installed?"

commands.observation: Offline CI gate succeeded; output showed bun run check && bun test with 83 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail.
Build succeeded and regenerated dist/nya plus runtime assets.
Built artifact printed the expected nya usage/help text.
Fresh temp-dir doctor output was valid JSON with dbExists=false, needsRebuild=true, and no .nya-cli side effects.
Canonical dist/tree-sitter asset directory contained web-tree-sitter.wasm and tree-sitter-typescript.wasm (18 files total).
Preferred offline end-to-end chunking check failed before completion because sqlite-vec could not be loaded by the built artifact in temp execution.
Direct runtime chunk verification using process.argv[1]=dist/nya succeeded and produced symbol-labeled TypeScript chunks.
Smoke returned status=passed with learn/search/ai-search counts and no detected literal API-key leak in captured stdout/stderr.

frictions.description: The preferred offline dist/nya learn git runtime check for VAL-OPS-031 could not complete in an isolated temp execution because the built artifact reported a missing sqlite-vec loadable extension.
frictions.resolution: Used a direct runtime chunk verification tied to process.argv[1]=dist/nya to isolate tree-sitter asset behavior after confirming the dist asset directory contents.

notes: CLI validation stayed offline except for the required bun run smoke:google execution.
VAL-OPS-031 used a local OpenAI-compatible embedding stub for the attempted offline learn git flow; the stub server was shut down after validation.
Smoke result: status=passed, secret source present, captured stdout/stderr did not contain the literal Google API key value.
